EmailTemplate.name: Director's Scholarship Letter 2015-16
EmailTemplate.subject: Congratulations on your scholarship
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
Congratulations on your exceptional high school achievements and your admission to ASU Colleges at Lake Havasu City. I am confident you will be an excellent addition to our community of scholars, and I look forward to welcoming you to ASU at Lake Havasu in fall 2015. In addition, it is a pleasure to offer you a scholarship as you pursue your studies.
You are being awarded a $1,000 ASU Colleges at Lake Havasu City Director's Scholarship based on your high school academic performance. This award can be renewed for an additional three years, for a total of four years. Renewal is dependent upon funding and your academic performance, and will be awarded only if you attend ASU Colleges at Lake Havasu City as a full-time student. This award is granted in addition to any other financial aid you receive.
In order for this award to be applied to your account, you will need to confirm your intent to attend ASU Colleges at Lake Havasu City by paying the enrollment deposit of $150 by may 31, 2015.
I commend your exemplary performance and welcome your meaningful contributions to ASU's tradition of excellence. If you have questions, I encourage you to contact your admission counselor, Laura Shuffler, at ASULauraShuffler@asu.edu or 928-854-9705 at your earliest convenience.
Welcome to ASU in Lake Havasu.
Go Devils!
David A. Young Director ASU Colleges at Lake Havasu City
